title: auditgen configuration
description: Operator attestations and report metadata. Every attestation defaults to false and stays false until you can evidence it; a declaration marked true is recorded in the report as attested rather than observed.

organizationName.description: Reporting entity name, used in generated documents.

systemName.description: Name of the system in scope, used in generated documents.

systemDescription.description: What the system does and who it serves. auditgen will not invent this; an empty value is reported as an unfilled field in the System Description.

hostingEnvironment.description: Where the system runs, for example "GitHub Enterprise Cloud, us-east-1, AWS EC2 t3.large".

dataCategories.description: Categories of information processed. Drives which confidentiality and privacy criteria are in scope.

trustServicesCriteria.description: Trust Services Criteria in scope. Defaults to the Security criterion.

frameworks.description: Frameworks to evaluate when none are passed on the command line.

repositories.description: Repositories to audit when one config covers several.

samplePullRequests.description: Merged pull requests sampled when checking review practice.

websiteUrls.description: Websites checked for published policies: security.txt, privacy notice, terms, status page, trust centre, subprocessor list. Tried in order, falling through to the repository homepage and then owner.github.io. Every URL is validated against an SSRF guard: only http and https, no private or link-local address, no credentials in the authority, redirects re-validated per hop.

twoFactorEnforced.description: ATTESTATION. Multi-factor authentication is enforced for all organisation members. GitHub exposes no API for this, so auditgen cannot verify it. Attach a screenshot of Settings > Authentication security to the auditor pack.

riskRegisterMaintained.description: ATTESTATION. A current risk register or threat model exists with owners and review dates. Covers SOC 2 CC3.2.

fraudRiskAssessed.description: ATTESTATION. A fraud risk assessment is documented, including how segregation of duties on merge rights is meant to work. Covers SOC 2 CC3.3.

backupRecoveryTested.description: ATTESTATION. Backups have been restore-tested against a documented RTO and RPO. Covers SOC 2 A1.2.

capacityManaged.description: ATTESTATION. Capacity is monitored against projected requirements. Covers SOC 2 A1.1.

trainingCompleted.description: ATTESTATION. Security awareness training is delivered and recorded, with policy acknowledgements. Covers ISO 27001 A.6.3.

physicalSecurityCovered.description: ATTESTATION. Physical and environmental security is inherited from the hosting provider's attestation rather than self-managed. Covers ISO 27001 A.7.4.
